notes.title: SPACE SURVIVORS EARLY ACCESS RELEASE
notes.content:
9 Months later and we are finally out and in early access!
It has been a journey to reach this point , but this is where I would say the real work starts!

Let us enjoy the game and create an awesome community together where we inspire each other!
Looking forward to everyones feedback and opinion and looking forward to what Space Survivors will evolve with your feedback !

I will do my best to keep the updates regular and frequent so that you always have something new and fun to test and enjoy in Space Survivors!

Cant wait to see your feedback in steam community or in the discord server!

[b] BIG THANK YOU TO EVERYONE THAT HAS BEEN AROUND AND WILL JOIN US ON THIS JOURNEY![/b]

notes.title: Big update reworking the upgrades system
notes.content:
[b]PATCH NOTES V0.5.0 [1/11/2024][/b]




[b]New Additions[/b]
- New Upgrades : Passive Items 
- Magnet Passive: Increases pickup range for xp
- Shield Passive : Increases player shield
- Health Passive : Increases player health
- Damage amp Passive : Increases overall player damage
- New upgrade system : You can now equip with the same type of weapons and stack a unique style for your self
[Feedback is needed for further balancing and making sure all weapons feel awesome]



[b]Changes[/b]

- Complete overhaul of the current level up and spawning system.
- Lowered the Kamikaze enemy damage
- Removed double immunity
- Removed boss locking animation


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Fixed bug where the first boss wasn't dropping loot or dropping too many
- Fixed visual bugs on the boss

- Damage amp Passive : Increases overall player damage
- New upgrade system : You can now equip with the same type of weapons and stack a unique style for your self

- Fixed visual bugs on the boss

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE V0.4.2 IS UP
notes.content:
New patch is live! try it and tell me what do you think!?


[b]PATCH NOTES V0.4.2 [19/10/2024][/b]



[b]New Additions[/b]
- Added an outline for the intractable objects in the space station .
- Added some helpful tips in hacking panel.
- Added drop marker , when cargo drops now you get a highlight incase you go away from it.
- Added language support , current languages [EN,DE].

[b]Changes[/b]

- Increased the speed of the event ending and doubled the size.
- Increased enemy overall damage.
- Increased gold drop from chests and enemies.


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Fixed manual aim [It still auto fires but you can aim at what you like] [Press Q to change firing mode].
- Fixed cooldown still running when game is paused causing visual error.
- Fixed bug where the proper previous selected name wasn't written.
- Fixed Visual bug on some weapons when you take rocket turret first saying explosion increase%.
- Fixed bug that made your weapons keep getting more stats.
